drafts.text: OpenSSH released a patch this week. Its allow you to bypass a check if you have a valid key and gain shell access to systems with the default configuration. It should be updated on most distro's by now update.

A new patch was released this past week from openssh to fix a vulnerability. An user could use their key to bypass a check and get a shell if they were able to connect to a machine. This would only be possible on machines that have an older version of openssh with the default configuration. Most distros have already patched but make sure to update today.

Openssh released an update this past week to address a vulnerability where you can use your public key to bypass one of there checks and gain a shell. If your using a default config this effects you. Make sure you update. Most distros have released the patch.
